bookshelf-plus v0.1.1

- 新增閱讀習慣追蹤功能：每日閱讀打卡、進度查詢、Streak、閱讀統計等腳本（reading_progress.py, reading_stats_dashboard.py, reading_cron.py）
- 增加「閱讀打卡」、「閱讀進度」等新觸發關鍵字
- 腳本清單和 Cron Job 區塊新增閱讀相關自動化提醒與統計
- 移除 skill-card.md，統一文件內容至 SKILL.md

Bookshelf Plus v0.1.0 – Major Upgrade to Library Management

- Adds multi-source ISBN lookup (Open Library + Google Books) for improved accuracy and coverage.
- Introduces full borrow/return lifecycle management with due dates, overdue reminders, and borrower tracking.
- Integrates batch import (CSV), barcode (image) ISBN scanning, and export/reporting features.
- Expands Notion database schema for progress tracking, book location, borrower info, and library health analytics.
- Provides automated overdue checks/reminders via scheduled jobs.
